meta.source: burned-in English captions visible in source video
meta.extraction_method: Local ffmpeg frame sampling only (no OCR, no external/cloud service). Frames pulled every 2s across the full 137.2s video and visually inspected by the assistant to locate the caption band and find caption-change windows; each change window was then refined with a 1s-resolution mid-point frame to narrow the boundary. Caption text was read directly off tight crops of the caption band at native 1920x1080 resolution and cross-checked against the wider frame. All processing was local; no video or frame was uploaded or sent to any network service.
meta.review_notes: All 14 caption boundaries landed on whole-second sample points during 1s-resolution refinement (no caption was observed changing mid-window), so timestamps are given at :00 milliseconds. This is the finest boundary precision the sampling strategy actually confirmed -- true cut points could fall up to ~1s earlier within the last 'absent' second observed for each transition. No caption text was ambiguous, obscured, or unreadable; every segment below was confirmed by direct pixel-level inspection of a cropped, upscaled still of the caption band. Three non-caption production slides (opening title 'RECEPTIVE SKILLS EVALUATION' / 'SIGN TO VOICE - CATEGORY: RELIGIOUS' / 'INSTRUCTION: Record yourself voicing the video', t=0-16s, and the closing 'RECEPTIVE SKILLS EVALUATION' card, t=~130-137s) were observed but intentionally excluded from segments: they are static production slides, not burned-in captions aligned to the signer's speech.

segments.text: I want to welcome you and share something positive and motivating about life.
What if you could have a positive relationship?
This service is surrounded by families and community.
Happiness comes from our hearts and our lives.
It is your decision, and it takes dedication.
Do not say in your heart, 'Who will go up to heaven?'
And do not say, 'Who will go down into the abyss?'
The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart.
This is the message of faith about salvation in Christ.
I'm not happy; I'm just trying to find a few things.
I'm sure this is about a relationship with Christ.
Here's a story: you're going to be a blessing.
